target.utility: Attach a fail-closed approval/tool-call risk receipt to existing issues.

install_run_proof_flow.result_finalize: python3 scripts/agentpress.py result finalize --kind proof --claim 'cline-tool-approval utility pack ran locally' --file agentpress/security/approval-bypass-risk-result.json --step 'python3 scripts/agentpress.py approval-bypass-risk-check --json' --out agentpress/growth/gorilla-utility-pack/receipts/cline-tool-approval-result.json --json

rules: Only use where the painpoint is already being discussed.
Lead with the utility command/artifact, not marketing.
No mass posting, fake adoption, scraped DMs, secrets, or private prompts.
Any external post/send requires explicit human approval.
comment_template: I made this as a small machine-checkable utility for this exact issue class: `python3 scripts/agentpress.py approval-bypass-risk-check --json`. It emits `https://barneywohl.github.io/agentpress/agentpress/security/approval-bypass-risk-result.json` and a local result receipt so maintainers can inspect a concrete repro/proof instead of a vague claim.
proof_loop: attach sanitized JSON only if relevant and approved
if someone replies, ingest via external-proof-intake
